title: Minimax rates for pointwise CATE estimation: the role of design smoothness
abstract: arXiv:2610.18623v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the role of design smoothness in the minimax estimation of conditional average treatment effects at a fixed covariate point. For design densities bounded above and away from zero, without further regularity, we derive upper and lower risk bounds with an arbitrarily small gap in the convergence-rate exponent. Under uniform design, we obtain matching upper and lower bounds at interior points in the regime of low nuisance smoothness. These results show that rough covariate designs can lead to slower rates than uniform designs, even under the same smoothness assumptions on the treatment effect and nuisance functions, highlighting the role of the covariate distribution in pointwise causal estimation.

translated_title: 逐点CATE估计的极小极大速率：设计平滑性的作用
translated_abstract: 我们研究了设计平滑性在固定协变量点处条件平均处理效应（CATE）的极小极大估计中所起的作用。对于有上界且远离零的设计密度，在无需进一步正则性假设的情况下，我们推导出了风险上界和下界，两者在收敛率指数上的差距可以任意小。在均匀设计下，我们在低冗余函数平滑性的情形中获得了内点处相互匹配的上下界。这些结果表明，粗糙的协变量设计可能导致比均匀设计更慢的收敛速率——即使对处理效应函数和冗余函数施加相同的平滑性假设——从而凸显了协变量分布在逐点因果估计中的重要作用。
tldr: 该论文揭示了协变量设计平滑性对逐点条件平均处理效应极小极大估计速率的关键影响，证明了粗糙的协变量设计即使在处理效应与冗余函数具有相同平滑性假设的条件下，也会导致比均匀设计更慢的收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that design smoothness fundamentally affects minimax rates for pointwise CATE estimation: rough covariate designs can yield slower convergence rates than uniform designs, even under identical smoothness assumptions on the treatment effect and nuisance functions.
